searched: Searched on 29 October 2026 (web search for discovery only; every passage copied from a retrieved copy): Google DeepMind leadership appointments and departures 2023–2026 (Gemini app leadership, Chief AI Architect, the August 2026 reshuffle, departures of Oriol Vinyals, Quoc Le, David Silver and Mat Velloso, departures to found labs); Meta's 2025–2026 AI reorganisations (the May 2025 split into AI products and AGI Foundations, the August 2025 four-group MSL structure, the March 2026 applied AI engineering organisation), MSL leaders named after the 30 June 2025 memo, self-announced MSL departures, Ruoming Pang's and Andrew Tulloch's Meta roles, and 2026 departures (Aparna Ramani, Rohit Patel). Primary texts used: Google's published note of 5 August 2026, X posts by Oriol Vinyals and Rishabh Agarwal (syndication endpoint), and Google Cloud's biography of Aparna Ramani. Internal memos (Chris Cox, May 2025; Alexandr Wang, August 2025; Maher Saba, March 2026; Ramani, April 2026) are unpublished and rest on the reporting that relays them (Axios, Bloomberg via Mobile World Live/Storyboard18/TechTarget/BTW Media, the Wall Street Journal via The Decoder, The Information via WinBuzzer). The Google DeepMind About page, retrieved, lists no leadership team. Vinyals's long post is truncated in the syndication text. Quoc Le's X post (as relayed) concerns co-founding Discovery Loop, not leaving Google, so his departure rests on VnExpress. No primary text could be found for Mat Velloso's moves (his LinkedIn posts are not admissible), so Brazilian trade reporting (Baguete) is used. Bloomberg, The Information, the Wall Street Journal and Semafor originals were not retrieved (paywalled); the relaying reports are cited instead.
